recordGrain: one tenant-local day x region x channel x sku

requiredFields.sku: non-empty stable product identifier, maximum 120 characters
requiredFields.category: non-empty product category, maximum 120 characters; functionally determined by sku within a snapshot
requiredFields.business_timezone: IANA timezone shared by every row in one tenant snapshot
requiredFields.currency_code: one ISO-4217 currency per tenant snapshot
requiredFields.paid_orders: non-negative integer not greater than visits
requiredFields.gmv: non-negative decimal with at most two fraction digits

visits.aggregation: additive only when adapter capability declares visits source-allocated at the record grain

gmv.numerator: SUM(gmv converted to integer minor units)

decimalAndRounding.ingestRule: reject values having more than two currency fraction digits
decimalAndRounding.sumRule: convert each accepted amount to integer minor units before aggregation
decimalAndRounding.displayRule: round half away from zero to two decimals only after all residual and contribution calculations

deduplication.snapshot: replace the complete adapter-owned snapshot and reject duplicate primary keys
deduplication.incremental: upsert stable source_line_id facts, reconcile all lines for every observed source entity, then recompute touched serving buckets
deduplication.sourceOwnership: a tenant/source writer must hold the connector ownership and checkpoint fence

lateData.completePartition: a date is queryable only when every required source published ready coverage for that tenant-local date
lateData.zeroFactDay: ready plus fact_row_count=0 is a valid zero-business day and is not missing data
lateData.materialCorrection: never mutate completed Evidence silently; publish a versioned correction and create a superseding run

capabilityDegradation.required: any unavailable flagship metric, unavailable flagship dimension, required-source audit failure, future/stale/missing required partition, or dimension coverage below 95% blocks flagship analysis and actions
capabilityDegradation.optional: refunds, margin, inventory, advertising, and business events may be unavailable; the run continues as degraded and may not make findings or actions about that capability
capabilityDegradation.reconciliation: KPI-tree decomposition is allowed only for same-source or explicitly audited cross-source numerator/denominator pairs

watermarkSynthesis.source: maximum source instant for which the adapter proves every preceding required tenant-local partition complete
watermarkSynthesis.multiSource: minimum watermark across sources required by the selected metrics
watermarkSynthesis.snapshotConsistency: one run freezes adapter revision, snapshot id, virtual clock, timezone, scope hash, and source watermarks before any business query

schemaEvolution.withinV1: new optional fields and optional capabilities may be added; meanings, primary key, required fields, metric formulas, and rounding rules may not change
schemaEvolution.breakingChange: publish a new commerce-data-contract major version and require an explicit adapter migration
schemaEvolution.unknownFields: readers may ignore unknown optional fields but must reject unknown enum values that affect semantics or safety

businessEvents.causalBoundary: temporal proximity alone never promotes an event-backed hypothesis to a causal driver
